notes.title: Patch Notes - April 14th, 2023
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Developer Notes[/b][/h2]

Hey Crafters! 

Small balance patch today with some minor bug fixes. Just over two more days until the Public Alpha ends and the servers go down. Make sure that you’ve finished your placement matches to secure your special Preseason One emblem.

[h2][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h2]

[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where stunning a unit would remove FBSS's attack speed stacks even if the unit did not switch targets. Thanks for the report @LastKardax

[*] Fixed a bug where pre-casting a basic spell on cooldown would not allow you to switch to casting an available respawn spell. Thanks for the report @TheRang

[*] Fixed some attack hit VFX being oriented incorrectly
[/list]

[u][b]Gameplay[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Solna: Reduced the duration of Block from 0.75s to 0.5s

[*] Solna: Holy Light recharge rate reduced 12s -> 13s

[*] Aster: Ensnare no longer deals damage, it is purely a utility stun. Reduced energy requirement 1500 -> 1250

[*] Ulla: Adding a small delay to Frost Shock to allow for counter-play opportunities and improved VFX so that players know who she is targeting
[/list]

[u][b]Art[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Tony got a new base, so he’s chilling on his bean bag, watching his favorite show. Unfortunately, Tony has eaten all of his Nachos, but we’re cooking up a fresh batch and will serve them up over the weekend!
[/list]

[u][b]UI/UX[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] When respawning unit’s, their respawn location and initial attack target are now previewed
[/list]

Please let us know what you think of the changes in the [url=https://discord.com/channels/760169602905800727/1087616177079058472]game-feedback forum[/url].

notes.title: Patch Notes - April 13, 2023 - Tony Tweaks
notes.notes:
[h2]Developer Notes[/h2]
Hey @Crafters! 

Hope you are all enjoying Tony being thrown into the mix. Now that we’ve got some initial data on how our favorite stone boy is doing we are tweaking some of his spells.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where a players could not exit the match end screen after hitting “Play Again” and cancelling. Thanks for the report Hotair!
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added telegraph to Aster’s Line 'Em Up
[*] Smash recharge rate increased 18s -> 22s
[*] Cannon Ball recharge rate increased 15s -> 18s
[*] Stone Form energy required 1500 -> 2000
[*] Purifying Gaze energy required 750 → 1000
[*] Holy Light recharge rate increased 10s -> 12s
[*] Rageblade lifesteal decreased 30% → 25%
[*] Energizing Spear restated to 100/10/10 and flat energy generation reduced 5% → 3%
[/list]

[h3]Art[/h3]
[list]
[*] New animation for Tony’s Soaring Smash
[*] Bug fix on Tony’s Gargoyle’s Descent animation where you could see him hovering at the top of the screen before he executes the spell
[*] Small tweaks to Hero rotations on Home Screen and Team Select, so they look more toward the camera
[/list]

Please let us know what you think of the changes in the [url=https://discord.gg/spellcraft]#game-feedback channel over on Discord[/url].

notes.title: Hotfix - April 12, 2023
notes.notes:
[h2]Developer Notes[/h2]
Hey Crafters! 

We just couldn’t wait for tomorrow’s balance update to deliver some fixes. It seems adding a third tank helped some players discover that the 'increased damage taken' debuff was no longer being applied after a prolonged duration of Overtime. Thank you Ayden Pride and Tasty for your late night discovery!

[h2]Hotfix Notes[/h2]

[u][b]Gameplay[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] The ‘Shootout’ debuff will be applied to each Hero during Overtime once 60 seconds have elapsed. ‘Shootout’ increases damage taken by all Heroes by 10%, stacks indefinitely, and cannot be dispelled. If a Hero respawns while ‘Shootout’ is being applied, it will spawn with the same number of stacks as all other Heroes on the board.
[/list]

Please let us know what you think of the changes in the [url=https://discord.gg/spellcraft]game-feedback forum on Discord[/url].

notes.title: Patch Notes - April 12, 2023 - New Hero: Tony!
notes.notes:
[h2]Developer Notes[/h2]
Hey Crafters! 

We’re over the moon by the response to the Spellcraft Public Alpha. Thank you so much for playing, streaming, and sharing feedback. We’ve been dropping a balance patch almost every day for the duration of the test, looking at data about how various strategies, Heroes and spells are performing across the MMR spectrum, and reading all of your feedback about how the game’s feeling. We’re back with another patch – this time with a big surprise.

One common request we’ve read was that it’d be nice to have another tank to choose from in the lineup, and so we decided to drop one. Here’s what Tony’s all about:

Tony is a disruptive tank who is not very fond of spell damage so when he drops below a certain health threshold he will gain massive spell resistance to shut down the haters.

Both of his basic spells will interrupt/stun enemies: one version hits all enemies in a line, while the other makes him fly across the map to interrupt one enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42381254/14ab2cc2baed61bf5f3b0ecc1502a1713d78ed85.jpg[/img]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] All MMR adjustments that were lost during our service outage have been restored, showing that Eurantien, not Arroz_con_Mango, was the first player to achieve Sovereign! Congrats Eurantien!
[*] The Sovereign ranked emblem should now properly display for players on the leaderboard.
[*] Fixed some text expanding outside a background on match summary
[*] “Hover Links” for upgrade descriptions will auto expand in the team builder, previously only links for the non upgraded spell were displayed.
[/list]

[u][b]Gameplay[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Added a new Tank Hero to the game – Tony, the Royal Guard.
[*] Xaev and Aster respawn abilities will always attempt to target the hovered row as long as there is an empty space for the hero to spawn
[*] Zap magic damage amp 30% → 40%
[*] Zap upgrade magic damage amp 50% → 60%
[*] Rocket Jump now restores 100 barrier on use
[/list]

[u][b]UI/UX[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Added a Patch Notes button to the home screen
[*] When hovering gems on the match summary screen, the stats for that round is displayed. Clicking will lock to displaying that round as it previously did.
[*] The item selection UI has widened a bit because it’s been sneakily eating candy bars out in the garage
[/list]

Please let us know what you think of the changes in the [url=https://discord.gg/spellcraft]game-feedback forum on Discord[/url].

notes.title: Patch Notes - April 11, 2023
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Developer Notes[/b][/h2]

Hey @Crafters! Welcome to buff day! We took a pass at spells that were underperforming and put some more oomph behind them. Also, we are experimenting with showing one additional item during the item phase. This means you will now always see one item per category. Finally, we’ve rebalanced the MMR brackets to better represent the current volume of players. We will adjust this again in future tests as the community grows.

Please keep telling us what you think in the [url=https://discord.com/channels/760169602905800727/1087616177079058472]game-feedback forum[/url]!

[h2][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h2]

[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Updated Vampirism Spell Vamp % to match the actual value 30% -> 40%

[*] Fixed a bug where Thorns would trigger on damage dealt effects. This only affected Reset’s attack speed passive but we avoid future bugs (phew)

[*] You can now bind right mouse button as a hotkey

[*] Fixed a bug where Shadow Dance could be continuously used FOREVER. FOR-E-VERR…
[/list]

[u][b]Competitive[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Ranked tiers have been rebalanced! Players should be able to rank up in ~2-3 games won against equally ranked players. 

[*] Players should see a substantial change in their current ranks. Players previously in Gold should see themselves in Platinum or even Diamond.
[/list]

[u][b]Gameplay[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Players will now be shown 4 items instead of 3 at the item phase. This means you will now always see one item per category.

[*] Rocket Jump cooldown reduced 6s -> 5s

[*] Rocket Jump Upgrade cooldown reduced 3s -> 1s

[*] Rocket Jump + Magnetic Pull/Push should now feel more responsive to use

[*] Ignite now scales off of Spell Power (50% SP base)

[*] Upgraded: 100% SP 

[*] Ignite Upgrade now spreads burning to ALL enemies on the board

[*] Combust on Burning targets now deals TRIPLE damage.

[*] Ice Lance cooldown reduced 7s -> 5s

[*] Frost Shock base now fully recharges when hitting an enemy with 5 stacks of frostbite

[*] Zap now scales with Spell Power instead of Attack Damage

[*] Zap spell power scaling increased 100% -> 200%

[*] Upgraded: 200% -> 400%

[*] Zap magic damage amp increased from 25% -> 30% and duration increased from 2s -> 5s

[*] Open Wounds starting charge count 0 -> 1

[*] Open Wounds cooldown reduced 7s -> 6s

[*] Open Wounds AD scaling increased 50% -> 100%

[*] Upgraded: 150% -> 200%

[*] Needle cooldown reduced 5s -> 4s

[*] Shadow Dance damage increased 50 (+50% AD) -> 100 (+100% AD)

[*] Upgraded: 100 (+100% AD) -> 200 (+200% AD)

[*] Tweaked description of Shadow Dance to make sure players learn they must RECAST this spell manually.

[*] We were seeing many players using this ability once during the activation period

[*] Cursed Circlet now triggers on any damage dealt, not just auto attacks. (Thank you Strohm!)
[/list]

[u][b]UI/UX[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] The in-world scoreboard is now visible post combat

[*] Player nameplates are now visual post combat
[/list]

Please let us know what you think of the changes in the [url=https://discord.com/channels/760169602905800727/1087616177079058472]game-feedback forum[/url]! forum.

notes.title: Patch Notes - April 7, 2023
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Developer Notes[/b][/h2]

Hello Crafters!

We’ve been listening to all of your thoughtful feedback, tuning into your live streams, and crunching the numbers, and we’re about to push out a balance and bugfix patch.

During these tests the development team is greeted every morning with the play metrics from the previous day. Tests like this are how we figure out what is broken, what is fun, and what could be fun (or more fun) if we made some tweaks.

Big changes this patch include a Europa tweak that should rein her in early in the match, while still letting her scale into a menace as Spell Power items come online. We’ve also poked and pulled at Bleed strats that were becoming a bit too dominant. And while we know Cage is counterable – especially at higher ranks – his Slam Dunk was a little overtuned.

Those balance changes and more, plus bug fixes, art and UX improvements, all going live right now. The game client will prompt you to restart and patch before your next match.

We'll continue to listen to feedback and look at data throughout the entire test to maximize learnings and ensure the game continues to be fun and doesn’t get stale. Thank you for playing so many games! Let us know what you think in the #game-feedback forum. We’ll see you in ranked queue!

[h2][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h2]

[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]

● “Invite to Game” on the main menu will now work after playing a Custom game.

● Fixed a bug where Giant Slice was dealing 250 less damage than expected to center space

[u][b]Known Issues[/b][/u]

● Sometimes Spell Scrolls aren’t visible in your Spellbar but are still castable with hotkeys.

[u][b]Gameplay[/b][/u]

● If your “Swab the deck” target tile is occupied, it will now prefer falling back to farther unoccupied spaces instead of closer.

● Bleed replaced with Poison. Poison increases physical damage and healing received by 5% per stack

--● Needle starting charge count 3 -] 1. Damage increased 1 -] 50. Upgraded damage 50 -] 100

--● Razertips Volley renamed to Corrosive Volley

--● Eviscerate damage decreased 200 (+200% AD) -] 150 (+150% AD) to compensate for how much harder this will now hit with Poison stacks.

● Our goals with Europa tweaks is to reduce her early damage a bit while still letting her scale into a menace as Spell Power items come online

--● Missile damage decreased 700 (+300% SP) -] 400 (+350% SP)

--● Missile Upgrade base damage decreased 1500 -] 1200

--● Grenade damage decreased 400 → 300

--● Grenade Upgrade damage decreased 600 → 450

--● Orbital Strike tweaks

----● Center damage decreased 1500 -] 1200

----● Upgraded damage decreased 2000 -] 1750

----● Orbital Strike ring damage decreased 750 (+100% SP) -] 600 + (150% SP)

----● Upgraded ring base damage decreased 1000 -] 875

● Ion Strike damage decreased 1500 -] 750

● Slam Dunk KO thresholds decreased 30/50% -] 25/35% respectively

● Restricted Zone AOE damage amp decreased 30% -] 20%. Fixed wording to ensure clarity that this is a global buff

● Shatter damage increased 500 -] 1000

● Frost Blink can be used to cancel out of Blizzard

[u][b]Art[/b][/u]

● Warding Dome visuals have been updated

● Improving readability of Meteor and Meteor Trail telegraph VFX

[u][b]Audio[/b][/u]

● Updated “Choose an item” voice line

● Fixed some 3d positional audio issues

[u][b]UX & UI[/b][/u]

● Ranked banner added to scoreboard

● The board will no longer be colored red when immediately trying to cast a spell that has just been cast

Please let us know what you think of the changes!

notes.title: Patch Notes - April 6, 2023
notes.notes:
[h2]Developer Notes[/h2]
Hello Crafters!

What an awesome first day of public alpha! Hope you’re all enjoying the game and climbing the ladder. We’re dropping a quick patch to address a couple of bugs and balance concerns we’re seeing.

Our goal is to ensure strategies are generally balanced, and that no one team is uncontestable. Bleed comps were feeling a little too spicy, so we’re tuning a few things based on the early data and feedback we’re reading.

Additionally, we’re squashing a whole buncha bugs. Thank you so much for your feedback, bug reports, and just for playing Spellcraft!

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
Spellcraft v1.20545

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Open Wounds Upgrade said Ines leaped to target when this isn’t the case
[*] Fixed a bug where Warding Dome wouldn’t immediately removes Spell Ward effect from allies when KO'd
[*] Fixed a bug where using Overpower on enemies only applied Burning for 5s instead of 10s
[*] Fixed a bug where Rocket Jump Upgrade wasn't actually recharging faster
[*] Fixed a bug where Squiddleston’s basic spells were not able to interrupt his Ultimate or Respawn spell
[*] Fixed issue with backing out of team select right as you were connecting to a match
[*] Fixed “new team” naming prompt not showing all team members
[*] Fixed some instances of units “warping” to their target tile instead of animating
[*] Fixed “auto respawn” not toggling during a match
[*] Fixed “ability” UI text string reference, and changed it to “spell”
[*] Fixed “relic” UI text string reference, and changed it to “item”
[*] Fixed “Overtime” Help and Tutorial strings for punctuation and description clarity
[/list]

[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*]Sometimes Spell Scrolls aren’t visible in your Spellbar but are still castable with hotkeys.[/list]

[b]Gameplay
[/b][list]
[*] Bleed damage decreased 20 → 8 per stack per second
[*] Bleed duration decreased 20s → 15s
[*] Open Wounds recharge decreased 8s -> 7s
[*] Solna's Block starting usage count 2 -> 1
[*] Razertips Volley base damage increased 100 -> 200
[*] Razertips Volley Upgrade base damage increased 200 -> 400
[*] Divine Intervention now instantly cleanses target ally
[/list]
